# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is a website of "**Building Agentic Solutions with Microsoft Foundry**" that will accompany the physical book to be published by O'Reilly Media in mid-2026.

Bringing AI into production involves much more than model deployment. Organizations need to control how agents access data, respond to users, and operate within governance policies. Microsoft Foundry offers a unified platform for building, scaling, and managing intelligent agents across an enterprise. This book helps you unlock its full potential through proven practices, clear examples, and actionable guidance.

This book serves as a hands-on guide for cloud engineers, AI developers, and technical leaders using Azure to implement enterprise-ready AI. You’ll learn how to deploy large language models, connect them to secure data sources, manage quotas and usage, and architect agentic workflows. This book will become a trusted reference as you bring intelligent agents into your organization.

- Deploy large language models using Microsoft Foundry services
- Configure retrieval-augmented generation with MCP tools to enable data access
- Build multi-agent workflows with Foundry IQ knowledge bases
- Monitor usage and track performance with built-in observability features
- Apply reference architectures and patterns suited for enterprise environments
- Govern compliant and secure AI applications with confidence using scalable management tools
